text:
mara: Quick questionwe need a clear audit row for auto-fallbacks. Ops keep asking: what exactly tripped and how confident are we?

jon: Can we add a tiny confidence breakdown? like: metric:0.6, samples:0.25, deploy:0.15 -> total 0.85.

lee: Yes. Also capture source tag (infra|model|client) and a severity enum (soft|hard|quarantine).

sam: UI should show the top 2 contributing metrics and a single sample request (redacted) with reason. Add a TTL on artifacts (14d).

mara: And a "reclassify" button so SREs can mark mislabels; it must append an immutable audit note with who changed it.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary rules v3 deployed to prod-eu at 2025-04-15T09:03:12Z :rocket:

jon: For flapping protection: if policy toggles >3 times in 10m mark flapping and suppress auto-actions. UI shows red "flapping" badge.

lee: we'll add promql examples in the editor help text and standardize `confidence` definition.

mara: Action items: jon -> audit schema draft; lee -> editor help + promql; sam -> quick wire for sample snippet. Back in 48h.

sam: dropping a few sanitized traces in #eng-platform-uploads with tag autofallback-sample.

mara: thanks.
